consequence.statement: The new refreshPolicy field is optional; existing ClusterExternalSecret resources continue to function without modification.

original.statement: A new optional field spec.externalSecretSpec.refreshPolicy was added to the ClusterExternalSecret v1beta1 schema.

decision.reason: [ev-9beeb11a214a] shows refreshPolicy as a new field (∅ → definition) in the ClusterExternalSecret v1beta1 schema between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0. The excerpt does not show it as required, and it does not show any rejection, ignored setting or failure for existing resources. The deterministic canonical:added/none check confirmed "none" against the bundle CRDs [ev-9889c9b8706d][ev-e08924afdc47]. So "none" (informational) is supported, and calling it an action kind would over-claim.
